source.title: Exposition on Psalm 17
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Expositions on the Psalms (Augustine) > Psalm 17

paragraphs.text: 1. This prayer must be assigned to the Person of the Lord, with the addition of the Church, which is His body.

2. <quote>Hear My righteousness, O God, consider My supplication</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:1}} . <quote>Hearken unto My prayer, not in deceitful lips:</quote> not going forth to You in deceitful lips. <quote>Let My judgment from Your countenance go forth</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:2}} . From the enlightening of the knowledge of You, let Me judge truth. Or at least, let My judgment go forth, not in deceitful lips, from Your countenance, that is, that I may not in judging utter anything else than I understand in You. <quote>Let My eyes see equity:</quote> the eyes, of course, of the heart.

3. <quote>You have proved and visited Mine heart in the night-season</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:3}} . For this Mine heart has been proved by the visitation of tribulation. <quote>You have examined Me by fire, and iniquity has not been found in Me.</quote> Now not night only, in that it is wont to disturb, but fire also, in that it burns, is this tribulation to be called; whereby when I was examined I was found righteous.

4. <quote>That My mouth may not speak the works of men</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:4}} . That nothing may proceed out of My mouth, but what relates to Your glory and praise; not to the works of men, which they do beside Your will. <quote>Because of the words of Your lips.</quote> Because of the words of Your peace, or of Your prophets. <quote>I have kept hard ways.</quote> I have kept the toilsome ways of human mortality and suffering.

5. <quote>To perfect My steps in Your paths</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:5}} . That the love of the Church might be perfected in the strait ways, whereby she arrives at Your rest. <quote>That My footsteps be not moved.</quote> That the signs of My way, which, like footsteps, have been imprinted on the Sacraments and Apostolical writings, be not moved, that they may mark them who would follow Me. Or at least, that I may still abide fixedly in eternity, after that I have accomplished the hard ways, and have finished My steps in the straits of Your paths.

6. <quote>I have cried out, for You have heard Me, O God</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:6}} . With a free and strong effort have I directed My prayers unto You: for that I might have this power, You have heard Me when praying more weakly. <quote>Incline Your ear to Me, and hear My words.</quote> Let not Your hearing forsake My humiliation.
7. <quote>Make Your mercies marvellous</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:7}} . Let not Your mercies be disesteemed, lest they be loved too little.

8. <quote>Who savest them that hope in You from such as resist Your right hand:</quote> from such as resist the favour, whereby You favour Me. <quote>Keep Me, O Lord, as the apple of Your eye</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:8}} : which seems very little and minute: yet by it is the sight of the eye directed, whereby the light is distinguished from the darkness; as by Christ's humanity, the divinity of the Judgment distinguishing between the righteous and sinners. <quote>In the covering of Your wings protect Me.</quote> In the defence of Your love and mercy protect Me. <quote>From the face of the ungodly who have troubled Me</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:9}} .

9. <quote>Mine enemies have compassed about My soul;</quote> <quote>they have shut up their own fat</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:10}} . They have been covered with their own gross joy, after that their desire has been satiated with wickedness. <quote>Their mouth has spoken pride.</quote> And therefore their mouth spoke pride, in saying, <quote>Hail, King of the Jews,</quote> {{BIBLE:mat 27:29}} and other like words.

10. <quote>Casting Me forth they have now compassed Me about</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:11}} . Casting Me forth outside the city, they have now compassed Me about on the Cross. <quote>Their eyes they have determined to turn down on the earth.</quote> The bent of their heart they have determined to turn down on these earthly things: deeming Him, who was slain, to endure a mighty evil, and themselves, that slew Him, none.

11. <quote>As a lion ready for prey, have they taken Me</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:12}} . They have taken Me, like that adversary who <quote>walks about, seeking whom he may devour.</quote> {{BIBLE:1pe 5:8}} <quote>And as a lion's cub dwelling in secret places.</quote> And as his cub, the people to whom it was said, <quote>You are of your father the devil:</quote> {{BIBLE:joh 8:44}} meditating on the snares, whereby they might circumvent and destroy the just One.

12. <quote>Arise, O Lord, prevent them, and cast them down</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:13}} . Arise, O Lord, Thou whom they suppose to be asleep, and regardless of men's iniquities; be they blinded before by their own malice, that vengeance may prevent their deed; and so cast them down.

13. <quote>Deliver My soul from the ungodly.</quote> Deliver My soul, by restoring Me after the death, which the ungodly have inflicted on Me. <quote>Your weapon: from the enemies of Your hand</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:14}} . For My soul is Your weapon, which Your hand, that is, Your eternal Power, has taken to subdue thereby the kingdoms of iniquity, and divide the righteous from the ungodly. This weapon then <quote>deliver from the enemies of Your hand,</quote> that is, of Your Power, that is, from Mine enemies. <quote>Destroy them, O Lord, from off the earth, scatter them in their life.</quote> O Lord, destroy them from off the earth, which they inhabit, scatter them throughout the world in this life, which only they think their life, who despair of life eternal. <quote>And by Your hidden things their belly has been filled.</quote> Now not only this visible punishment shall overtake them, but also their memory has been filled with sins, which as darkness are hidden from the light of Your truth, that they should forget God. <quote>They have been filled with swine's flesh.</quote> They have been filled with uncleanness, treading under foot the pearls of God's words. <quote>And they have left the rest to their babes:</quote> crying out, <quote>This sin be upon us and upon our children.</quote> {{BIBLE:mat 27:25}}

14. <quote>But I shall appear in Your righteousness in Your sight</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 16:15}} . But I, Who have not appeared to them that, with their filthy and darkened heart, cannot see the light of wisdom, <quote>I shall appear in Your righteousness in Your sight.</quote>

<quote>I shall be satiated, when Your glory shall be manifested.</quote> And when they have been satiated with their uncleanness, that they could not know Me, I shall be satiated, when Your glory shall be manifested, in them that know Me. In that verse indeed where it is said, <quote>filled with swine's flesh,</quote> some copies have, <quote>filled with children:</quote> for from the ambiguity of the Greek a double interpretation has resulted. Now by <quote>children</quote> we understand works; and as by good children, good works, so by evil, evil.

latex.p0003: 1. 此祈祷当归于主位格，并加上作为祂身体的教会。
latex.p0004: 2. \BibleQuote{天主，请听我的正义，垂顾我的恳求}\BibleRef{咏 16:1}。\BibleQuote{请倾听我的祈祷，不出于欺诈的口唇：}不出于欺诈的口唇而走向祢。\BibleQuote{愿我的判断从祢的面容发出}\BibleRef{咏 16:2}。因祢光照的认识，让我判断真理。或至少，愿我的判断发出，不从欺诈的口唇，而是从祢的面容，即我在判断时不说话语以外我所领悟于祢的。\BibleQuote{愿我的眼睛看见正直：}当然，是心灵的眼睛。
latex.p0005: 3. \BibleQuote{祢在夜间考验并眷顾了我的心}\BibleRef{咏 16:3}。因为我的心曾因考验的苦难而被证实。\BibleQuote{祢以火锻炼我，在我身上找不到不义。}现在不仅是黑夜（因它常扰乱人），而且火（因它燃烧）也称为苦难；藉此我受考验时被找到是正义的。
latex.p0006: 4. \BibleQuote{使我的口不谈论人的行为}\BibleRef{咏 16:4}。使我的口不出任何言语，除非关乎祢的荣耀和赞美；而不谈论人的行为——那些违背祢旨意的事。\BibleQuote{因祢嘴唇的言语。}因祢和平或祢先知的言语。\BibleQuote{我持守了艰难的道路。}我持守了人类必死和受苦的劳苦道路。
latex.p0007: 5. \BibleQuote{使我的脚步在祢的路上得以完全}\BibleRef{咏 16:5}。为使教会的爱在狭窄的道路上得以完全，她由此抵达祢的安息。\BibleQuote{使我的脚步不致动摇。}使我的道路的标志——如同脚步，已印在圣事和宗徒著作上——不致动摇，让那些愿跟随我的人能标记它们。或至少，在我完成艰难道路、在祢路径的狭窄中走完我的脚步后，我能永恒不动地安住。
latex.p0008: 6. \BibleQuote{我呼求了，因为祢应允了我，天主}\BibleRef{咏 16:6}。我以自由而有力的努力向祢倾注我的祈祷：因我能有此能力，祢在我更软弱祈祷时已应允了我。\BibleQuote{求祢侧耳听我，垂听我的言语。}愿祢的听闻不抛弃我的卑微。
latex.p0009: 7. \BibleQuote{使祢的仁慈奇妙}\BibleRef{咏 16:7}。愿祢的仁慈不被轻看，免得它们被爱得太少。
latex.p0010: 8. \BibleQuote{祢拯救那投靠祢的人脱离反抗祢右手的人：}脱离反抗祢恩待我的恩宠之人。\BibleQuote{求祢保护我如眼中的瞳仁}\BibleRef{咏 16:8}：它看似非常微小，但藉它，眼睛的视线得以定向，从而区分光明与黑暗；正如藉基督的人性，审判区分义人与罪人的神性得以辨别。\BibleQuote{在祢翅膀的荫庇下保护我。}在祢慈爱和怜悯的庇护下保护我。\BibleQuote{脱离那些困扰我的恶人的面}\BibleRef{咏 16:9}。
latex.p0011: 9. \BibleQuote{我的仇敌围绕了我的灵魂；}\BibleQuote{他们封闭了自己的脂肪}\BibleRef{咏 16:10}。\BibleQuote{他们的口说了骄傲的话。}因此他们的口说了骄傲的话，说：\BibleQuote{犹太人的君王，万岁，}\BibleRef{玛 27:29}以及其他类似的话。
latex.p0012: 10. \BibleQuote{他们抛弃我，如今围绕了我}\BibleRef{咏 16:11}。他们把我抛弃在城外，如今在十字架上围绕了我。\BibleQuote{他们决意把眼睛转向地上。}他们决意把内心的倾向转向这些地上之事：认为被杀者遭受了极大的不幸，而他们这些杀他的人却安然无恙。
latex.p0013: 11. \BibleQuote{他们像预备捕食的狮子擒拿了我}\BibleRef{咏 16:12}。他们擒拿了我，正如那仇敌\BibleQuote{四处巡游，寻找可吞噬的人。}\BibleRef{伯前 5:8}\BibleQuote{又如一只住在隐密处的幼狮。}又如它的幼崽，就是那曾被告知\BibleQuote{你们是出于你们的父亲魔鬼}\BibleRef{若 8:44}的百姓，他们谋划着陷阱，用以算计并毁灭那义者。
latex.p0014: 12. \BibleQuote{上主，求祢起来，迎击他们，推翻他们}\BibleRef{咏 16:13}。上主，求祢起来——祢被他们以为在沉睡，不关心人的不义——愿他们先被自己的恶意弄瞎，以致惩罚先于他们的行为；然后推翻他们。
latex.p0015: 13. \BibleQuote{求祢从恶人手中拯救我的灵魂。}求祢拯救我的灵魂，在我死后恢复我——那恶人加给我的死亡。祢的武器：脱离祢手的仇敌\BibleRef{咏 16:14}。因为我的灵魂是祢的武器，祢的手，即祢永恒的大能，曾拿起它用以征服不义的国度，并将义人与恶人分开。那么，求祢将这武器从祢手的仇敌——即祢大能的仇敌，也就是我的仇敌——中解救出来。\BibleQuote{上主，求祢将他们从地上消灭，在他们今生中分散他们。}上主，求祢将他们从他们所居住的地上消灭，在他们仅视为生命的今生中分散他们于普世——那些绝望于永生的人。\BibleQuote{他们因祢隐藏的事物而肚腹饱足。}如今，不仅这可见的惩罚会临到他们，而且他们的记忆也被罪恶充满——这些罪恶如同黑暗，隐藏于祢真理之光之外，以致他们忘记天主。\BibleQuote{他们饱尝了猪肉。}他们被不洁充满，践踏了天主圣言的珍珠。\BibleQuote{并把剩余留给他们的孩子：}他们喊道：\BibleQuote{这罪归于我们和我们的孩子。}\BibleRef{玛 27:25}
latex.p0016: 14. \BibleQuote{但我将因祢的正义在祢面前显现}\BibleRef{咏 16:15}。但我——并未向那些以污秽暗淡之心不能见智慧之光的人显现——\BibleQuote{我将因祢的正义在祢面前显现。}
latex.p0017: \Quote{当祢的光荣显现时，我将获得饱饫。}当他们因自己的不洁而饱饫，以致不能认识我时，当祢的光荣显现时，我将在认识我的人中获得饱饫。确实，在那句经文说\Quote{充满了猪的肉}的地方，有些抄本作\Quote{充满了孩子}：因为希腊文的歧义导致了两种解释。现在，藉着\Quote{孩子}我们理解为行为；正如好的孩子代表好的行为，同样恶的孩子代表恶的行为。
